Arenella, Vomero (Municipalità 5) — Naples, Italy

Average day Average night

In detail

A mostly residential, middle-class hill district. Local press in January 2025 documented a real cluster of incidents in a two-week span — an attempted double burglary on Epiphany night near Mercato De Bustis, a violent phone-snatching assault on a young couple in Piazza Leonardo, a smash-and-grab at a bank branch on Via Cimarosa, and thefts from a pub and a church sacristy — prompting a public appeal from a local residents' association for better police coordination. At the same time, the local prefetto's own official year-end tally reported recorded crime in Vomero as down, not up. Both of these genuine, dated data points are disclosed here rather than picking one: a residential area with a real recent theft cluster, but not one where official figures show it getting worse overall. Sources checked: InterNapoli.it, 23 Jan 2025 (Vomero crime cluster and resident appeal); NapoliToday.it (prefetto's year-end report: recorded crime down in Vomero).
